name: Сопливый элементаль
alt: Зелёный сопливый элементаль сморкается в крошечный платочек.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms and strong silhouette. Large centered subject, comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: One huge translucent lime-green mucus elemental, a rounded gelatinous body with exactly two blobby arms and two short stubby feet, one lumpy face with an enormous runny nose. It blows its nose into an absurdly tiny white handkerchief held in both hands; puffed cheeks and embarrassed watery eyes. Little glossy drips, comical rather than disgusting, no gore, no detailed filth. Minimal stone floor.
